Abstract.AbstractText: A quinoline-based fluorescence probe has been prepared and characterized. Probe 1 showed a selective sensing ability for Al3+ and Fe3+ ions through fluorescence enhancement response at 515nm when it was excited at 360nm. In the presence of Fe3+ ion, probe 1 exhibited a detection limit of 2.10×10-6M. As for Al3+, its detection limit of 3.58×10-7M was significantly lower than the highest limit of Al3+ in drinking water recommended by the WHO (7.41μM), representing a rare example in reported fluorescent probe for Al3+ ion. The fluorescence microscopy experiments have demonstrated that probe 1 could be used in live cells for the detection of Al3+ and Fe3+ ions.
